newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Some basis levels rise.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Some basis levels rise.

text.p: Weather-related delays in grain transportation caused basis levels for dark northern spring wheat to rise Friday at some locations in Minnesota, North Dakota and Montana, dealers said.

"We had snow and high winds up in the Dakotas again yesterday. What I'm hearing is they think it's going to take a few days before we get (railcars) coming in again," a trader at the Minneapolis Grain Exchange said.
MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed, with nearbys gaining on the delays and on bullish export sales data, traders said.
Grain dealers in Portland said cash bids were four cents per bushel higher than Thursday's noon bids because of higher MGE March spring wheat futures and because of moderate to good exporter demand.
One Montana dealer said sales activity in the state had been slow Friday, possibly because many merchandisers were attending a statewide grain elevator convention.
